messages:
maria: Heads up — long streaming session memory keeps growing on canary. +1.2GB over ~5h on svc-runtime 0.9.2. Tool-loop traffic with repeated tool calls.
aj: Can you paste kv pool stats? Which region?
maria: us-west1-c, dedicated node pool. Quick kv dump:
```
KV_POOL_STATS
total_pages: 84200
active_slots: 12734
pinned_pages: 18320
fragmented_slots: 4123
avg_slot_size: 128
evictions: 624
```
leo: pinned_pages looks high. Any correlation with kernel selection or batching changes in last deploy?
maria: we rolled batching heuristic tweak yesterday (continuous-batch-threshold lowered to 16). Also kernel selector updated to prefer int8 fastpath for some layers.
sophia: can you repro locally with long-context simulator? try `--streaming=true --tool-loop=repeat:20`
maria: Repro script and a short pprof run attached. Patch produced this snapshot:
```
$ curl -s localhost:9000/debug/pprof/heap -o heap.pb
$ go tool pprof -top heap.pb
(pprof) top
22.4%  22.4%  runtime.mallocgc
15.1%  37.5%  github.com/redwood/runtime/kv.(*Pool).pin
9.8%   47.3%  github.com/redwood/runtime/session.(*Session).Append
...
```
aj: Pin path in Pool.pin — maybe slow reclaim or missing unpin in tool-loop when tool returns early. Any recent changes to slot reuse?
maria: We added a GC grace window to avoid thrash (grace_ms=5000). Maybe interacting bad with streaming long contexts.
leo: Could be fragmentation: many small allocations prevented coalescing. Try running slab defrag counter, also run `jeprof` if using jemalloc.
maria: Ran a small experiment: reduced grace_ms to 500 and mem growth flattens. But saw higher tail latency. Data attached.
sophia: Tradeoff expected. Let's instrument KV metadata for last-touch timestamp and eviction latency. If last-touch not updated on tool-loop fast-path, that would explain.
aj: Quick patch idea: touch when append returns (cheap). Also add periodic background compact once per 10s when long-session flag set.
maria: I'll push a canary with touch-on-append and compacter off by default. Will report back in ~2h.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy canary/runtime-0.9.3-canary1 to us-west1-c at 1745555388
maria: :thumbsup: thanks. If this stabilizes, we'll tune batching threshold back.
